task: Owner-approved Phase 1 design change (D-COMPLIANCE-VERDICT-SOURCE): derive portal compliance framework verdicts from paginated per-resource Trivy reports joined via ClusterComplianceReport.spec.compliance.controls[].checks[].id so portal works accurately under both trivy-operator 0.25.0 (identical live output) and 0.36.1 with reportRecordFailedChecksOnly="false" (explicit success:true -> tested-passed, ignoring buggy CCR status.detailReport success:false and inflated status.summary.failCount).

events.summary: Verified ClusterRole/narwhal-portal in gitops/charts/narwhal-platform/templates/narwhal-portal-k8s.yaml already grants get/list/watch on all 6 per-resource Trivy report kinds plus clustercompliancereports (zero RBAC widening). Scoped strictly to portal verdict source, pagination, types, UI tested-pass display, behavioral tests, R392/R393 paged-fetcher updates, and docs/trace. Left untouched: RBAC manifests, trivy-operator chart (Phase 2), kube-bench.ts, kisa.ts, cache-keys.ts, acceptance rules.

Prior upstream v0.36.1 inspection proved FromDetailReport hardcodes Success:false for MisconfStatusPassed entries and TotalsCheckCount increments failCount++ while large CCRs exceed etcd 1.5 MiB. In portal/src/lib/compliance.ts (~L2121-2139), reading detailReport.results[].checks and status.summary.failCount classified passed checks as failures.

Recorded D-COMPLIANCE-VERDICT-SOURCE in portal/src/lib/compliance.ts. Added complianceK8sListPaged/tryComplianceK8sListPaged (limit=200, metadata.continue, single 410 restart, fail-closed on truncation) across per-resource report lists and ReplicaSets. Replaced detailReport.results[].checks verdict parsing with per-resource report joins (controlEvidenceFailures + scope-restricted controlEvidencePasses) keyed by spec.compliance.controls[].checks[].id normalized via resolveCanonicalCheckId (including KSV-0001/KCV-0033 without colliding KSV0012/KSV012). Added optional testedByReport, reportTestedPassCount, and testedPassCount (omitted when 0 so 0.25.0 output is byte-compatible) and wired UI tested-pass display. Fix round (after R1 independent review): (1) extracted resolveEffectiveNodeTypes + inScopeReportsForPasses so controlEvidencePasses counts passes only from in-scope reports matching family, scanner, kinds, namespaces, and nodeType/commands (preserving missing_node_type, excluded_namespace, no_report_in_scope_namespace, unsupported_kind, and mixed-family G2 scope checks); (2) updated classifyNonFailingControl so a control with >=1 in-scope explicit success:true and 0 failures on any mapped check is tested-passed even when CCR detailReport is absent and another in-scope mapped check has no record.
